education.description: Management degree received in 2002. Institution normalized to canonical form per university_names.json ("Open University of the U.K." is a listed alias of "The Open University"). Round 2: both Kommersant profiles (2021 and 2025) and the prospectus consistently call this a management "degree" (степень), but none specify whether it is a Bachelor's-level award, an Open University Business School Professional Diploma, or a Professional Certificate -- a genuine ambiguity given that Russian executives of this era commonly obtained OU Business School diploma/certificate-level credentials rather than full undergraduate degrees, and media routinely renders any of these as "degree". No primary transcript or OU alumni record was found to disambiguate, so qualification_degree is left null rather than guessed. Quality pass round 1 (2026-07-30): a fresh web search surfaced Vedomosti's 16 December 2020 profile (vedomosti.ru/business/characters/2020/12/16/851287-fix-price-4000-kopii), which explicitly calls this credential "степень MBA ... в Открытом университете Великобритании" (an MBA degree). This conflicts with the official 2021 IPO prospectus and both Kommersant profiles, none of which use the word MBA for this specific credential -- the prospectus reserves that term for the separate, explicitly-named 2007 Plekhanov MBA-Synergy programme. Because the prospectus is the more rigorously fact-checked, legally-accountable primary source and itself distinguishes the two credentials, Vedomosti's "MBA" label is treated as a probable journalistic simplification rather than a confirmed fact; qualification_degree stays null and Vedomosti is added to ceo.sources to document this unresolved conflict rather than silently adopting either label.

Management degree received in 2003. Round 2: institution string already matches its own canonical entry in university_names.json (no normalization needed). Quality pass round 1 (2026-07-30): Vedomosti (16 December 2020) independently confirms he "окончил" (graduated/completed) this institution in the specialization "менеджмент организации" (organizational management) -- stronger completion wording than the prospectus's generic "degree", but still without specifying Bachelor's vs. diploma/certificate level, so qualification_degree stays null.

validation_notes: Processed 3 people from FIXP rows in MOEXBMI_2024.csv. Checked 2 local documents before web search: FixPrice_ar24.pdf and Fix Price IFRS Cons FS 24-e.pdf. Completed 1 research round for each person, 3 rounds total. CEO was set to Dmitry Kirsanov because the local 2024 annual report and 2024 financial statements identify him as CEO/Managing Director; the CSV role for Vladimir Pogonin was resolved as CEO/General Director of LLC Best Price, the operating subsidiary, from 1 July 2024. Education was not confirmed for Elena Mironova. Weak sources were used only as leads or auxiliary confirmation: MarketScreener for investor-relations contact and RBC Companies for current LLC Best Price register-style data; LinkedIn snippets for Mironova education were not used. Rejected namesakes include Dmitry Kirsanov the web-design author and unrelated academic/literary results, Vladimir Vasilyevich Pogonin in Moscow public-sector contexts, and academic Elena Mironova profiles without Fix Price affiliation. No confirmed scientific publications, patents or h-index were found for any processed person. Search is considered complete because local documents were checked first, official sources and business media confirmed key roles for Kirsanov and Pogonin, separate education/experience/research/namesake searches were performed, and two search passes produced no new higher-quality leads for Mironova's missing education. ROUND 2 (2026-07-18): (1) Company-level sector/industry_group/industry added: Consumer Staples / Consumer Staples Distribution & Retail (New Name) / Consumer Staples Distribution & Retail (New Name), copied verbatim from gics_taxonomy.json; Fix Price is a fixed-price variety/discount retailer (self-described as 'a leading value retailer'), the same GICS bucket already used in this project for the comparable Russian retail chain APTK and consistent with how global dollar-store/variety-store peers are classified under the post-2023 GICS structure. (2) The same triple was copied onto every professional_experience entry whose organization's primary business is documented retail (Fix Price Group PLC, LLC Best Price, Kopeika, Monetka, and the Kopeika franchisee partner company); Coffee Trade Company and Soft Pro (Kirsanov, 1994-1997) were left null/null/null because a targeted check could not determine their line of business. (3) qualification_degree was added to every education[] and degrees[] entry for all three people: 'MBA' for Kirsanov's Plekhanov/MBA-Synergy entry (high confidence, from the programme's own name) and 'Specialist degree' for Pogonin's Serpukhov military-engineering entry (high confidence, standard Soviet 5-year pre-Bologna engineering programme); Kirsanov's Open University and International Business Academy entries (education[] and the combined degrees[] entry) were left null because, despite two additional Kommersant profiles being re-checked this round, no source specified the exact academic level of these credentials and Russian executives of this era frequently held Open University Business School diploma/certificate-level (not Bachelor's-level) qualifications under the same loose 'degree' wording. (4) Institution names normalized to their university_names.json canonical forms: 'Open University of the U.K.' and the combined 'Open University of the U.K. and International Business Academy' string both map to 'The Open University'; 'Plekhanov Russian University of Economics' maps to its Russian-language canonical name; 'International Business Academy' and Pogonin's Serpukhov institution already matched their own canonical entries verbatim and needed no change. No institution encountered this round was missing from university_names.json, so new_institutions_found is an empty list. (5) Gap-fill research: the 2021 IPO prospectus Board of Directors table (previously only used for career/education facts) was re-read in full and revealed that Kirsanov was appointed to the Fix Price Group PLC board in 2021 as 'Executive Director', distinct from his 2007 LLC Best Price CEO appointment and from the 2024 'CEO and Managing Director' title bundle already in the JSON; this let the previously-null start_year of the existing 2024 role entry be filled (2024, per Interfax's 1 July 2024 date) and a new 2021-2024 Executive Director professional_experience entry to be added for Kirsanov, without deleting or contradicting any previously confirmed fact. Two further Kommersant profiles (2021 and 2025) were re-read for Kirsanov's Coffee Trade Company/Soft Pro roles and MBA-Synergy completion status; role at Coffee Trade Company/Soft Pro is still not specified anywhere and remains null. For Mironova, LinkedIn, MarketScreener and the 2022 annual-report contact page were re-checked and none yielded new, independently verifiable education or employment-start-date facts, so her education[] stays empty and her professional_experience start_year/end_year stay null, consistent with the project rule to prefer null over an unverified guess. No previously confirmed fact was deleted or overwritten in this round.
